response.sql:
WITH budget_event_joined AS (
    SELECT e.type,
           CASE WHEN b.amount != 0 THEN b.spent / b.amount ELSE NULL END AS spend_ratio
    FROM budget b
    INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent != 0
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT type,
           AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_spend_ratio
    FROM budget_event_joined
    GROUP BY type
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_spend_ratio) AS mean_of_averages
    FROM type_averages
)
SELECT ta.type,
       ta.avg_spend_ratio,
       ta.avg_spend_ratio - om.mean_of_averages AS distance_from_mean
FROM type_averages ta
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
ORDER BY ta.type;

assumptions.assumption: Lines where amount = 0 produce NULL ratios, which are ignored in the AVG calculation per the 'ignoring missing values' instruction (avoiding division by zero)
distance_from_mean is the signed difference (type_average − overall_mean), not absolute distance
